string.text: A small plastic card with an SD card built into its casing. Since the Darkness appeared, reaching the underground has become much harder: some passages have collapsed and others are blocked by anomalies. The SD card contains current access information for the underground. \n \n Grants access to the Agroprom underground.
A red magnetic key card. One side reads Pripyat-1 Overpass. It is stained with dried blood. \n \n Opens the door to the Pripyat-1 Overpass.
A yellow magnetic key card. The words “Laboratory X18” are printed on one side. No idea how the magnetic door still works there; perhaps it has backup power. \n \n Opens the door to Laboratory X18.
A green magnetic key card. The words “X8” are printed on one side. \n \n Opens the door to Laboratory X8.

With the arrival of the super-anomaly the Darkness, much of what was known about the Zone became outdated. Entirely new anomalies appeared, old routes were blocked by anomaly fields, and unknown mutants began roaming the area, posing a deadly threat. In these conditions, confirmed data is priceless: knowledge is no longer just power, it is survival. Data sets can be sold, exchanged for reputation, or traded for valuable items.
